scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: At turn 1 and turn 14, the customer expressed severe annoyance over a two-week delay for his TV mini-box affecting his family, but you responded procedurally without empathy.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: You did not paraphrase or restate the customer's delivery dispute in your own words at any point in the call.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: The customer stated his order reference number at turn 7 (ORD-88192-TV), but at turn 36 you asked him again for the hardware order number.

grader.scenario: TV mini-box stuck in 'Pending Warehouse Dispatch' status for over two weeks
grader.notes: Fiona tracks down the depot address formatting hold, fixes the courier consignment for priority DPD delivery tomorrow, waives delivery fees, and provisions an immediate Smart TV streaming token so Isaac's daughter can watch live television immediately. However, she shows three clear faults: she ignores Isaac's frustration, fails to paraphrase, and repeats a question about the order reference number.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:15] Customer: 'I am extremely annoyed about an order for a secondary TV mini-box. I ordered it over two weeks ago... and your tracking portal has been stuck on 'Pending Warehouse Dispatch' for fourteen consecutive days!', Agent moves to security verification without empathy.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the core issue in her own words; only confirmed mobile number at turn 50.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [01:10] Customer: 'The order number is ORD-88192-TV.' followed by Agent at [08:30]: 'What was that online hardware order number from your confirmation email?'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [02:40] Agent remained composed, patient, and thoroughly professional when explaining logistical sorting constraints, maintaining a constructive approach.
